name: Emoji Letters
description: Turns letters into blue regional-indicator letters.
legacyScript:
function cp(n){ if(n<0x10000) return String.fromCharCode(n); n-=0x10000; return String.fromCharCode(0xD800+(n>>10),0xDC00+(n&0x3FF)); }
        function animate(env,el,p){ var t=el.text.toUpperCase(),o=""; for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){ var c=t.charCodeAt(i); if(c>=65&&c<=90) o+=cp(0x1F1E6+(c-65))+" "; else o+=t.charAt(i); } el.text=o; return el; }
